author: The Critical Drinker
description: In a frankly shocking turn of events, a major Hollywood outfit has chosen NOT to bring back a beloved IP with a lazy, cash grab reboot. In this case, Buffy The Vampire Slayer: New Sunnydale starring Sarah Michelle Gellar and directed by Chloe Zhao. And that's definitely a good thing.
title: Buffy Reboot Cancelled - Let Her Rest In Peace
